content: A combination of audio and textual features were utilized in BIBREF26 , BIBREF27 , BIBREF28 to predict and restore punctuation, including pitch, intensity and pause duration, between words. We ignore these features in our experiment because our main task—Thai sentence segmentation— does not include audio features.
